title: Estimating the concurrence for quantum states via symmetric measurements
summary: Concurrence is one of the most well-known entanglement measures. We show that, for arbitrary bipartite states, the lower bound of concurrence induced by symmetric measurements is always tighter than the one obtain from realignment. Besides, we derive an extended version of lower bound of concurrence induced by symmetric measurements, which can also be experimentally identified without state tomography, and further present a corresponding lower bound of genuine tripartite entanglement concurrence.
